asset_spec.concept: A high-quality stylized wooden treasure chest with a curved separate lid, substantial dark metal bands wrapping the frame, real hinges, corner hardware, side handles, a front lock, and softened manufactured edges. Designed for a Three.js learning scene with controlled look-development in Blender.

design_brief.concept: A high-quality stylized wooden treasure chest with a curved separate lid, substantial dark metal bands wrapping the frame, real hinges, corner hardware, side handles, a front lock, and softened manufactured edges. Designed for a Three.js learning scene with controlled look-development in Blender.

parts.connection_strategy: Root parent of chest assembly. Lid pivots from its back edge.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin at base center, Z=0 on ground plane.
identifying_features: Warm wood planks with visible grain direction running lengthwise (X-axis)
Slight outward bow on front/back faces (0.01m displacement)

parts.connection_strategy: Pivots from hinge axis at back-top edge of base. Two hinge knuckles connect lid to base.
parts.pivot_requirement: Pivot point at back-top edge of base, centered X, Y=-0.5m (back), Z=0.70m. Rotation axis = X-axis. Open range: 0 to 110 degrees.
identifying_features: Flat back wall flush with base back
Front vertical lip (0.15m tall) overlapping base front
Continuous wood grain wrapping the curve

parts.connection_strategy: Bolted appearance via small rivet bumps (0.01m diameter) spaced every 0.15m along band length.
parts.pivot_requirement: No independent pivot. Positioned on front face of base.
identifying_features: Four horizontal bands on front face at Z = 0.08, 0.28, 0.48, 0.68
Slight gap (0.005m) between band and wood surface for layered read
Four horizontal bands on back face mirroring front
Wraps onto sides by 0.12m, meeting front band wraps

parts.connection_strategy: Conforms to lid surface. Rivets along curve.
parts.pivot_requirement: No independent pivot. Moves with lid parent.
identifying_features: Two curved bands wrapping lid dome front-to-back
Positioned near lid edges at X = ±0.48m

parts.connection_strategy: Base knuckle fixed to base back-top edge. Lid knuckle fixed to lid back-bottom edge. Pin rod connects both.
parts.pivot_requirement: Hinge axis coincident with lid pivot at Y=-0.5m, Z=0.70m, X=-0.48m.
identifying_features: Real mechanical articulation when lid rotates

parts.pivot_requirement: Hinge axis at Y=-0.5m, Z=0.70m, X=+0.48m.

parts.connection_strategy: Mounted on front face center at Z=0.35m. Slight offset 0.005m from wood surface.
identifying_features: Rectangular plate centered on front face

parts.connection_strategy: Pivots from top attachment point on lid front lip. When closed, overlaps lock plate front.
parts.pivot_requirement: Pivot at top of hasp, on lid front lip center. Rotation axis = X-axis. Range: 0 (closed, vertical down) to -80 degrees (open, lifted).
identifying_features: Moves with lid, can also rotate independently

parts.connection_strategy: Mounting plate fixed to left side face center. Handle loop protrudes outward 0.12m.
parts.pivot_requirement: No independent pivot. Handle is rigid loop.
identifying_features: Rectangular mounting plate with corner rivets
Positioned at left side center, Z=0.35m
Positioned at right side center, Z=0.35m

parts.connection_strategy: Fixed to front-left bottom corner. Wraps both front and left faces.
Fixed to lid apex. Moves with lid.
identifying_features: Rounded dome boss at lid apex
Four surrounding rivets in square pattern

parts.connection_strategy: Embedded in wood surface geometry as grooves.

material_slots.intent: Primary surface material for chest body and lid. Reads as crafted oak planks with visible grain, warm tone, and subtle plank seam grooves.
Dark forged iron for all hardware: bands, hinges, lock, handles, brackets, ornament. Reads as heavy, slightly weathered metal with subtle highlights on bevels and rivets.

acceptance_criteria: Curved lid silhouette reads clearly as semi-cylindrical dome from all angles
Four horizontal metal bands visible on front and back faces with rivet detail
Two real hinge mechanisms with visible knuckles and pin rods at back-top edge
Lid rotates 0-110 degrees on X-axis without mesh intersection or clipping
Lock plate centered on front face with keyhole cutout and ornamental relief
Lock hasp attached to lid, rotates independently 0 to -80 degrees
Two D-shaped side handles protrude 0.12m from side faces with mounting plates and rivets
Four corner brackets wrap bottom corners with visible rivets
Wood and metal material regions are clearly distinct and non-overlapping
Plank seam grooves visible on wood surfaces defining individual boards
All exterior edges bevelled (0.015-0.02m) for clean stylized read
Pivot hierarchy supports lid opening animation in Three.js without manual repositioning
Procedural fallback materials produce acceptable silhouette read without texture maps
benchmark_priorities: silhouette: strong curved-lid read with domed top and flat front lip
proportion: lid-to-base ratio 42:58 with substantial band coverage
coherent_assembly: real hinge articulation, hasp overlap, band wrapping continuity
semantic_material_regions: clear wood vs metal separation, no bleeding
edge_treatment: consistent bevels on all exterior edges, softened manufactured read
useful_detail: rivets, keyhole, plank seams, ornamental relief, corner brackets
animation_readiness: pivots correctly placed for lid and hasp rotation

warnings: The design brief has few silhouette-identifying features.
